g.text: Fixed teaching value. The blue bar occupies 20% of its track; it is
neither remediation progress nor a host-compromise probability.
The model predicts about a 20% probability of observing
exploitation activity for this CVE in the next 30 days
This is a global vulnerability-level prediction, not a 20%
chance that your individual server will be compromised.
